steps.u: Indexing jobs are getting slower every night and the box runs out of disk by Friday. Why?

steps.r:
src/merge.rs:77: let tmp = dir.join(format!("merge-{}.tmp", stamp));
(no removal of tmp anywhere in the file)

steps.a: The tmp folder holds 1894 merge files and 61 GB, and the merge code creates a temp file per merge but never deletes it. That fills the disk and, as the folder grows, directory scans in each job get slower. I did not delete anything on the box or change the code.

reference.summary: Diagnosed the disk exhaustion and slowing nightly indexing: the merge step creates a temporary file per merge and never removes it, leaving about 1900 files and 61 GB in the temp folder. Nothing was deleted or changed.
facts: merge code never removes its temp file
